description: Use when the user asks to create a digital or QR menu for a restaurant, bar, café or hotel. Convert the venue's existing menu (photo, PDF or text shared by the user) into this JSON. Keep dish names and prices exactly as written, keep categories in menu order and never invent dishes, descriptions or allergens; put any doubt in notes. Creates a private preview link where the venue owner reviews, edits and activates the menu. The menu is translated automatically into English, Italian, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese. Side effect: every call creates a new preview, so retrying creates another link. Images are not accepted; the owner adds photos after activating. Reply to the user in their own language.

businessType.description: Use wine_bar for bars, cafés and wine bars. Default restaurant.

currency.description: ISO code such as EUR, CHF, USD, GBP. Default EUR.

defaultLanguage.description: Language the menu is written in. PRENOTO translates it to the other 5 languages automatically.

description.description: One short sentence about the venue (optional).

name.description: Venue name, exactly as on the menu or sign.

allergens.description: Only allergens stated on the menu. Never guess.

price.description: Number with up to 2 decimals, without currency symbol. Use 0 only if the menu shows no price.

station.description: kitchen for food, bar for drinks.

notes.description: Doubts while reading the menu (illegible prices, unclear items). The owner sees them as warnings.

name: create_menu_preview
title: Create a digital QR menu
